slides.title: One month out: the ==4-week plan== that actually works
Find your leaks first
slides.body: Take one full timed practice test and list every miss by skill, because you can't fix what you haven't named. Most students skip straight to grinding — and spend four weeks polishing skills they already had.

slides.title: Drill the leaks, not the test
slides.body: Daily targeted drills on your weakest three or four skills, plus *one* full timed test each week with every miss reviewed the same day. A full test every day is the classic burnout trap — volume without review teaches you nothing new.

slides.title: Taper and sharpen
slides.body: Pacing runs, Desmos fluency, light review of your trap list — nothing new after Wednesday. The night before is for sleep, because test-day sharpness is worth more than one more practice set.
slides.tip: Confidence is a skill; train it too
